(Currently Amended) Claim 15: The method of operating a data distribution system, comprising: receiving a media request at a first server computer; accessing a second server computer through a computer network, the second server computer being a Web application server; generating a path through the computer network to the second server computer, the path including one or more information servers; and providing data from the second server computer to a client computer, the data referencing the requested media, the data including a unique signature only if the unique signature is part of the media request.

(Currently Amended) Claim 24: The system for data distribution, comprising: a first server computer; a second server computer, the second server computer being a Web application server; a computer network for accessing the second server computer; and a media request broker configured to select the first server computer based on the information, wherein the unique signature identifying a media request is only required if the media request contains such a signature.

(Currently Amended) Claim 27: The computer program product for facilitating server communication in a data distribution system, comprising: software that, when executed, causes the computer to perform the steps of receiving a media request at a first server computer; accessing a second server computer through a computer network, the second server computer being a Web application server; and generating an http request, wherein the http request contains a unique signature identifying a media request only if such a signature is present in the media request.
